raw_vs_normalized_pitch.note: Relative centering removes global offset mathematically; full pipeline pitch-shift robustness can still fail alignment.

native_vs_warped_duration.note: A token-progress axis collapses duration by definition; scoring uses native elapsed seconds.

single_vs_compound: See per-recording results and per-event.csv; no independent human causal rating.
ordinary_vs_sham: See evaluation control event counts, reported separately by condition in recording_scores.json.
